rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and zip to a single account, then used read-only tools to review orders. It identified that the guessed order did not contain a camera and located the correct delivered order with the digital camera. After confirmation, it executed the return on the correct item and order, and confirmed refund to the original Mastercard ending in 8484. All actions were within policy: authenticated user, correct order, confirmation before write, and accurate final information. No unsupported claims or policy violations were observed.
